title: Sign in simply
intro: Use a passkey saved on your phone or another device.

first_time: First time? Set up an account or passkey
existing_account: Already have an account? Sign in

reset_intro: Choose a new password for your account.

reset_sent: If this email belongs to an account, a password reset link has been sent.
